text:
Lina (Marketing): Quick ask — we need a short QA + rerun of the demo measurement protocol before Wed webinar. Goal: confirm the latency/variance claims in the deck and grab artifacts for press.

Lina (Marketing): What we need from eng/runtime:
- p50/p95 token latency traces (per-route) for the demo payloads
- cold-start vs warmed KV-cache comparison
- quantized vs fp16 numbers (same seed)
- sample payloads with chain-of-custody (which sample set and orig timestamp)
- raw run logs + run command + config
- minimal reproducible rerun command we can point to in docs

Lina (Marketing): ETA? We can accept aggregated CSV + tarball of logs.

Raj (Eng Runtime): Ack. I can run a quick sweep. Confirm: model=redwood-alpha-v1 (or a close open variant?), seq_len=1024, batch=1, concurrency=1, warmup=2k tokens, measure=20 runs. Any changes?

Michelle (Eng Runtime): Please pin model hash + disable autoscale for the run. Also set --no-fallback so results deterministic.

Raj (Eng Runtime): Proposed quick command:
```bash
./bench/run_inference.sh --model=redwood-alpha-v1 --seq=1024 --batch=1 --concurrency=1 --warmup=2000 --runs=20 --quant=fp16 --out=out/webinar_fp16.csv
```
For quantized:
```bash
./bench/run_inference.sh --model=redwood-alpha-v1 --seq=1024 --batch=1 --concurrency=1 --warmup=2000 --runs=20 --quant=q4_0 --out=out/webinar_q4.csv
```
I'll tag each run with git SHA and upload to s3://redwood-internal/marketing/webinar-1745556789/

Omar (Data): For sample provenance use this format: sample_id,orig_ts,source,hash. We can sign artifacts with our sig tool:
```bash
sha256sum payloads.tar.gz > payloads.sha256
gpg --detach-sign payloads.sha256
```

Casey (PMM): Lina — can marketing accept a single CSV with per-sample latencies + separate agg file for p50/p95?

Lina (Marketing): Yes fine. Also include a README.md with exact commands and env (CUDA version, driver, host specs).

benchbot: Scheduled rerun job 87234 on runner gpu-20. ETA ~45m. Logs streaming: https://ci.redwood.com/jobs/87234

Raj (Eng Runtime): Started the sweep. Will post artifacts + short notes when done. Will mark runs as 'coldstart'/'warmed' in filename.

Lina (Marketing): Amazing, please ping here when upload complete. :thumbsup:

Michelle (Eng Runtime): Quick note — if we see >10% variance in p95 we may need a longer run to stabilize. Will check.

Raj (Eng Runtime): Upload complete: s3://redwood-internal/marketing/webinar-1745556789/README.md s3://redwood-internal/marketing/webinar-1745556789/webinar_fp16.csv s3://redwood-internal/marketing/webinar-1745556789/webinar_q4.csv s3://redwood-internal/marketing/webinar-1745556789/payloads.tar.gz s3://redwood-internal/marketing/webinar-1745556789/payloads.sha256

Lina (Marketing): Received. We'll use these in slides and link artifacts in the appendix. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
